name: herdr-pointr
description: Point at a DOM element on a localhost page and it lands in the coding agent that owns that project, with its React component, selector, styles and a screenshot.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsup && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o dist/pointr ./bridge
scripts.scenarios: tsup client/dev/anchor-scenarios.ts --no-config --format iife --platform browser --target es2020 --out-dir dist/scenarios --silent && cp client/dev/anchor-scenarios.html dist/scenarios/ && echo "Open dist/scenarios/anchor-scenarios.html in a browser: every row must read PASS."

author: aristeoibarra <aristeoibarra608@gmail.com>
